No hiring option can be put forward yet: the £400k annual-salary constraint was not assessed in this run.

- The comparison is **very fragile** and rests entirely on Olumi-authored estimates, especially platform delivery capacity; small assumption changes can alter the ordering.
- The model also lacks a stated objective sense for “shipped by Q3”, so it ranked higher goal values by assumption rather than your confirmed definition.
- The salary limit remains recorded, but needs attaching to the specific model component it constrains before compliance can be tested.
